title: Free tutorial: Your first display filter
summary: Open a packet capture and use display filters to find a script being downloaded.

next.title: Seminar 1: Reading evidence: packets, Linux, Windows and network sensors

script.intro: Welcome. A packet capture has thousands of packets and you need three. Display filters are how you find them.
script.outro: Filters turn a haystack into a story. Seminar 1 continues with the beacon and the network sensor.
steps: Read the setting so you know the company, the date and the time zone. Then open the evidence in the case folder.

The capture is the core switch mirror from 01:15 at Tamarind Health. Start with every HTTP request. Then everything to or from the download server. Then follow the stream of the first download to read the conversation. The first request's User-Agent is Wget, which matches the sudo line in the server log. The second is curl, which matches the script. The Linux cell asks tshark the same question on the command line, which is how you do it at scale.
